This game is the definition of a 7 out of 10 game.  They get the look and feel of a space marine down, with excellent vocals, wonderful environments, and the sense of being able to take on the horde.  The problem with the game is it is extremely repetitive, with the same enemies coming at you time and time again.  The game only has one real boss fight, and although it is a nice step away from the norm, there is not enough of it.  The final boss just becomes a quick time event, the first of which in the entire game.  The game is fun one time through, especially the times you get a jetpack and get to act as an assault class.  The story is overall ok, nothing special.  The only thing that really shined in this game was the multiplayer, which by the time you get to it is probably dead.  If you and some friends can find a server then jump on cause it is a blast.

This is a very entertaining and tense Space Marine themed action game with a good story and fun multiplayer.
The major downside is that there are not that many people in multiplayer. That means that waiting for a match may take a couple of minutes - especially if you want to play some DLC like the really great Chaos DLC which brings another online mission to the game.
I advise you to get the game when it is on sale again and not buy the DLC unless it is on sale as well. SEGA should really offer the DLC for free otherwise it is a waste of money.
